key.bg2ergonomics.clipboard: Clipboard History (tap: list, hold + scroll: flip)

key.bg2ergonomics.move: Hold + scroll: slide toward the side you point toward

bg2ergonomics.overlay.slide: Slide toward the side you point toward

bg2ergonomics.message.noservermirror: Mirroring needs BG2 Ergonomics on the server too
bg2ergonomics.message.entrytoolarge: Too big for this server: it copies at most %s blocks
bg2ergonomics.screen.clipboardempty: Empty. A copy is saved here when you switch to Paste.
